theme_and_archetype.archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) combined with Archetype 5 (Premium/Luxury touches)
theme_and_archetype.description: A dopamine-driven, playful yet premium aesthetic. We use high-contrast vibrant accents against a warm, pearl-like off-white background. The 'Meow Eyes' identity is expressed through subtle cat-eye geometry, amber tones, and tactile game-like interactions. It avoids flat/generic corporate looks by leaning into editorial typography and asymmetrical bento layouts.

rules.typesetting: Tight tracking on large headings (tracking-tighter), loose leading on body text (leading-relaxed).

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-meow-midnight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-meow-midnight
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-meow-salmon

rules.prohibited: Purple gradients on white background, generic deep teal.
rules.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Ensure midnight or dark gray text on light backgrounds. Salmon and Amber are for CTAs and highlights.
rules.hover_states: Must explicitly set hover text and background colors (e.g., hover:bg-meow-salmon_hover hover:text-white).

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs to let the premium products breathe.

grids.customer_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 or gap-8. Mix spans like col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create asymmetry.
grids.admin_control_room: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Every pixel utilized, h-full on children.

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense content. Avoid center-everything disease.

surface_strategies.headers: Crystal Glass. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 with a delicate 1px border-b border-meow-midnight/5.
surface_strategies.customer_cards: Playful Geometry. rounded-[32px] rounded-br-[12px] bg-white shadow-sm border border-meow-midnight/5. Hover adds -translate-y-1 and shadow-lg.
surface_strategies.gamification_elements: Neumorphism (Tactile). For buttons in mini-games and roulette to invite touch. Use soft shadows paired with sharp 1px inner borders.
surface_strategies.admin_dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-zinc-200), rounded-2xl, no shadow by default.

buttons.primary: bg-meow-salmon text-white font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 transition-all hover:bg-meow-salmon_hover hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95 shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgba(255,107,107,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-meow-midnight font-bold rounded-full px-8 py-4 border-2 border-meow-midnight transition-all hover:bg-meow-midnight hover:text-white
buttons.gamified: bg-meow-amber text-meow-midnight font-black rounded-2xl px-8 py-4 border-b-4 border-[#D98200] active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 transition-all

component_patterns.badges: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider bg-meow-mint/10 text-meow-mint
component_patterns.inputs: Shadcn based. rounded-2xl border-2 border-transparent bg-zinc-100 focus:bg-white focus:border-meow-salmon focus:ring-4 focus:ring-meow-salmon/20 transition-all
component_patterns.bottom_navigation: Mobile-only. fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 bg-meow-midnight/90 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-full flex justify-between items-center px-6 py-4 shadow-2xl z-50 text-white

iconography.style: Clean, scalable. Use subtle cat motifs where appropriate (e.g., Cat icon for profile/mascot, Glasses icon for catalog). Stroke width 2px.

customer_facing_features.homepage: Hero banner with dynamic product layout (playful cat + glasses aesthetic). Flash sale countdown using tactile bento cards. Horizontal scrolling marquee for brand benefits.
customer_facing_features.catalog: Left sidebar or top horizontal modern filter (category, brand, frame shape). Product cards must show variant colors as small colored dots. Hover to reveal 'Try On' or alternate angle.
customer_facing_features.product_detail: Massive product gallery (max-h-[80vh]). Right side sticky details. Sticky 'Add to Cart' bar on mobile.
customer_facing_features.cart_checkout: Simplified layout. Security PIN verification step modeled with clear input masks. Mocked shipping (EVERPRO) and payment (DOKU) integrations.

gamification.mini_games: Dedicated pages for Puzzle, Tetris, Matching Card. Use Vibrant Play archetype colors here. Big tactile buttons.
gamification.roulette: Spin wheel interface with sound/motion references. Rewards: vouchers, points, free shipping.

admin_cms_features.dashboard: Chart.js or Recharts for visual reports (Sales, Top Products, Game Engagement). High-contrast data visualization.
admin_cms_features.tables: Shadcn tables. Dense layout, pagination, export to Excel button prominently displayed.
admin_cms_features.management: Forms for CRUD operations across products, inventory, games, promo. Use side-drawers (Sheets) or Modals for quick edits to preserve context.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Check all text against backgrounds using APCA.
accessibility_and_testing.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all gamification elements.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-shop-button', data-testid='cart-checkout-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the custom Tailwind colors (meow-midnight, meow-salmon, meow-amber) in tailwind.config.js.
Import 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Figtree' fonts. Apply them globally in index.css.
Build the customer layout with the Crystal Glass sticky header and mobile bottom navigation.
Build the gamification modules (Roulette, Mini-games) using framer-motion for playful animations.
Use Shadcn components for complex inputs, dropdowns, and admin tables, but heavily customize them to match the 'Meow Eyes' premium playful aesthetic.
Mock payment with DOKU flow and shipping with EVERPRO flow.
Ensure the Admin CMS is responsive and uses Recharts/Chart.js for the dashboard.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements for automated testing.
